policy: Lists longer than 30 items become count and canonical-JSON SHA256; all other values are copied exactly. Full lists remain in local diagnostics.json. No metric is recomputed.

owner.definition: GT directed face-pairs present in all five fixed snapshots; 16-point bidirectional squared nearest-neighbor means summed. Macro summary of each object's mean/max. Missing/extra pairs excluded from this geometry subset and reported separately.

limitations: Two new snapshots were fixed before test; results do not select a new official model.
No same-budget original-GAT control at 28k steps; continuation changes are not an architecture-only causal comparison.
Owner errors cover only common GT directed pairs in all five snapshots; missed/extra pairs and coverage are separate.
Squared sampled distances are not linear CAD tolerance or maximum error.
Post geometry includes all computable objects and is separately paired on common computable cohorts; it is not restricted to valid solids.
Signed tail contribution fractions may exceed 100% because other objects offset the change. No outliers are excluded.
